question: Which three-billion-US-dollar agreement did the Asian Development Bank (ADB) sign with the World Bank, marking its first-ever EEA with the World Bank and its sixth with other multilateral development banks since 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sovereign Exposure Exchange Agreement (EEA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Asian Development Bank (ADB) signed a three-billion-US-dollar Sovereign Exposure Exchange Agreement (EEA) with the World Bank to increase ADB’s lending capacity for developing countries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This agreement is ADB’s first EEA with the World Bank and its sixth such agreement with other multilateral development banks since 2020.**
 
• **The total exchanged amount through these EEAs has reached 9 billion dollars.**
 
• **EEA is a risk management tool designed to reduce portfolio concentration risks, thus increasing lending capacity.**
 
• **Roberta Casali, ADB Vice-President for Finance and Risk Management, highlighted the transformative nature of exposure exchanges in enhancing ADB’s reach and reducing concentration risk.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Asian Development Bank (ADB)**__

 __
 
• Established in 1966, ADB is a regional development bank aimed at promoting economic and social development in Asia.
 
• Its headquarters are in Manila, Philippines, and it is composed of 68 member countries.
 
 
 
• **World Bank**__
 __
 
• Founded in 1944, the World Bank provides financial and technical assistance to developing countries worldwide.
 
• The bank’s headquarters are in Washington, D.C., USA.
 
 
 
• **Sovereign Exposure Exchange Agreement (EEA)**__
 __
 
• EEA is a financial arrangement where multilateral development banks exchange a portion of their sovereign credit exposure to reduce risks associated with concentration.
 
• It helps in diversifying credit portfolios and enhancing the lending capacity of institutions like ADB.
 
 
 
• **Capital Usage and Lending Capacity**__
 
 
• By reducing exposure concentration through EEAs, ADB optimizes capital usage, thereby increasing its lending capacity.
 
• This tool enables the bank to extend more funds to developing nations for infrastructure and development projects.
